name: Call of Water
summary: You leave the Barrens for a pure spring in Forsaken-held Tarren Mill. Its water will help Brine prepare the Water Sapta, and its survival offers hope.

sections.title: A Miraculous Spring
sections.body: Brine sends you across the sea to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. She needs water there to prepare the Water Sapta. Human resistance and the newly allied Forsaken surround the town, yet its small central well gives pure spring water. To Brine, it is a sacred remnant of cleanliness in an unhallowed land.

sections.title: Endurance in Darkness
sections.body: For Brine, the pure well in Tarren Mill is more than an ingredient. She sees its endurance in Warchief Thrall, who bore hardship, captivity, and sorrow before rising to lead the orcish people. Thrall gives the Horde hope. The well shows that life and purity can endure through tragedy and corruption.

faq.q: Where is the water sample collected?
faq.answer: You draw the sample from the well at the center of Tarren Mill, an old human settlement in Hillsbrad Foothills now held by the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does Brine send you so far away for water?
faq.answer: Brine needs distinct water essences to brew the Water Sapta, which lets shamans perceive elemental spirits. She found this spring on an earlier journey into Hillsbrad and values its purity amid Forsaken decay as potent and instructive.
Tarren Mill is a modest human town in northern Hillsbrad Foothills. Sylvanas Windrunner's Forsaken now hold it as a fortified Horde outpost against local human forces.

faq.q: How does this quest connect to Thrall?
faq.answer: Brine compares the pure well to Warchief Thrall. Though enslaved and made to suffer, Thrall kept the strength and vision to lead the new Horde, as the well keeps its freshness amid plague and death.

faq.q: What happens after returning the filled waterskin?
faq.answer: Brine accepts the filled red waterskin. She tells you she needs one more distinct water sample to finish the reagent mixture for your Water Sapta.

faq.q: Why is the well's purity considered unusual?
aliases: why is tarren mill water pure
faq.answer: Much of Lordaeron was defiled by the Scourge's plague of undeath, and Forsaken settlements are rarely linked with fresh springs. Yet Tarren Mill's central well still gives pristine water, a rare uncorrupted remnant.

angles.text: As a shaman, you travel far for water. You learn to seek harmony and life amid the bitter lands of the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a Horde warrior or shaman born in Kalimdor, you visit Tarren Mill and meet the Forsaken, your uneasy new allies at the front line against Hillsbrad's human defenders.
As an orc, you can reflect on Thrall's legacy of survival and strength, and the heavy price paid for your freedom.
